Changelog ÔÇö v1.3 ┬À 2026-07-30

  • v1.3 map pins + filters: Pins are colour discs by vs national average (┬▒3 pp bands) ÔÇö no rank digits. Toolbar: min/max score %, vs-national select, weak section (below that sectionÔÇÖs country avg). Click a pin to open Dealer radar.
  • v1.2 with map: Map tab ÔÇö Leaflet + OpenStreetMap / CARTO pins for the full IDS network; hover shows dealer score %, country national average %, and delta (pp).
  • MIDI FR/IT/ES/CH geo: Pins use MIDI_FR.xlsx NETWORK Town + Latitude/Longitude (exact DLRName match). Switzerland uses NETWORK Town city centres when lat/lon are blank. Removes the country-centre jitter blobs for those four countries.
  • UK CV geo: Extra city pins from Isuzu Truck UK store pages / public dealer addresses for residual names without an Address row.
  • Map fitBounds: Europe/Israel core only on open ÔÇö French overseas dealers (R├®union / Martinique / Mayotte) stay on the map when MIDI NETWORK confirms them; zoom out or filter to France to see them. R├®union is labelled Saint-Pierre (R├®union), not Madagascar. Sanity fails if a non-overseas drawn pin sits outside country bounds.
  • City-token scope: Country-scoped tokens (e.g. Sofia) cannot false-place a Greece dealer in Bulgaria.
  • Poland geo fix: Pins use city centres inferred from the IDS result-report Address row (Toru┼ä, Warszawa, Krak├│w, Pozna┼ä, Gdynia, ÔÇª) ÔÇö not the country-centre jitter blob near ┼ü├│d┼║.
  • Network geo + sanity: Address-row city matching expanded (Greece, Belgium, Denmark, Norway, UK LCV, NL, ÔÇª); word-boundary tokens (no BilboelÔåÆBilbao); builder geo sanity warns on country-centre blobs / tight clusters and fails if Poland/Portugal/Greece/Belgium/France/Italy/Spain/Switzerland city coverage regresses.
  • Radar charts: removed dark ÔÇ£Weak sectorÔÇØ overlay wedges and floating Weak labels ÔÇö clean dealer / country / network polygons only.
  • All UI labels in English (good / medium / bad ÔÇö no Dutch goed/slecht).
  • Country names in English: Switzerland / France / Italy / Spain (not MIDI_CH etc.).
  • UK LCV (IUK ÔÇö I.M. Parts & Service, D-Max), UK CV (ITUK ÔÇö Isuzu Truck UK), Israel LCV (UMI IDS pack ÔÇö never blended with UTI), Norway (RSA).
  • Benelux kept; Belgium, Netherlands and Luxembourg also shown as separate countries (map prefers non-Benelux pins when both exist).
  • Overview strengths / weak points: per section AÔÇôE, based on max-point items (full score = good, zero = bad) ÔÇö not ÔÇ£first question in sectionÔÇØ.
  • Dealer total is % of scored max (280 AÔÇôE, or 253 AÔÇôD when Section E is not scored). Network GPS capture is not hardcoded here (Portugal meeting lock 63.3% stays on the Portugal / Imotors pack only).
  • Section E not scored: Israel LCV (UMI) 29 dealers recorded 0/18 questions, 0/27 points, fill not_scored. That is not a fail. Totals restated on AÔÇôD; those zeros are excluded from the network Section E average and from the network total. Hover any network-average figure for the note.
